futures.name: Capability stalls, the rules stay unsettled
futures.says: Scaling runs out before whole jobs are in reach, and the gains come from spreading what already works.

futures.name: The money stalls, the rules stay unsettled
futures.says: The spending outruns the revenue it needs, and the losses fall on the investors who paid for it.

futures.name: Steady progress, the rules stay unsettled
futures.says: Capability keeps improving, firms adopt it at the pace of past technologies, and growth rises without exploding.

futures.name: Steady progress, courts and insurers price the risk
futures.says: Clear rules settle who pays for AI's mistakes, and adoption speeds up where they do.

futures.name: Steady progress, oversight comes first
futures.says: Agents and the firms behind them must register before they deal; licensing who may build the models, Kapoor and Narayanan argue, would not work.

futures.name: AI automates research, the rules stay unsettled
futures.says: Each model speeds up the research behind the next and output breaks away; in Restrepo's model, wages then settle at the cost of the computing that could replace a person.

futures.name: AI automates research, oversight comes first
futures.says: In the story's slower ending, a committee of the leading lab and the government slows the race until the systems can be checked.

businesses.kills: Regulators accept the seller's own tests.

made_by.method: One model read each published business beside the site's readings of the value chain and each future the outlook's grid fills, gave the business a call with one line of reasoning and the one thing that would undo it, and said in words what each future does to it. A future it left out changes nothing.
made_by.reviewed_by: a separate reviewing run of the same model, which changed calls, takes and reasons, withdrew some effects and added others; no person reviewed each one

not_judged.name: Control slips away, the rules stay unsettled
not_judged.why: No writer on the site says what this future does to any business, and a model's guess at it would be decoration.
